731:t_002:47.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And so I followed their orders and set out on an endless journey in search of the $$スフィア$$s.」

731:t_002:48.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So in the end, you just did as they told you.」

731:t_002:49.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No. It was to strike them down with the power of the $$スフィア$$s.」

731:t_002:50.en:
$$アサキム$$
「They thought they were controlling my mind. But my black wings shook it off.」

731:t_002:51.en:
$n
「Why did you join hands with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

731:t_002:52.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Even though he was one of the $$御使い$$s, I thought he was different from the rest of them...」

731:t_002:53.en:
$$万丈$$
「According to $$サクリファイ$$, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was banished from the $$御使い$$s around the same time that $$至高神ソル$$ shattered and became the $$スフィア$$s...」

731:t_002:54.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So the one who cursed $$アサキム$$ was one of the $$御使い$$s other than $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

731:t_002:55.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But in the end, he was just another one of the $$御使い$$s after all... It's the same disappointment you felt with $$サクリファイ$$.」

731:t_002:56.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is why I seek the power to destroy every last one of the $$御使い$$s... the $$スフィア$$s!」

731:t_003:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$シュロウガ$$! And so many of them!」

731:t_003:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As I am now, creating this many isotopes is nothing to me.」

731:t_003:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh no...! This is bad! This is really bad, you know!?」

731:t_003:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The one controlling those $$シュロウガ$$ is $$黒の英知$$!」

731:t_003:6.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$黒の英知$$...! Like the $$スフィア$$s, it's a fragment of $$太極$$ that brings knowledge and power to whoever touches it...!」

731:t_003:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To have that many of something like that!」

731:t_003:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I found them while I was searching for the $$スフィア$$s.」

731:t_003:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「CHRONO H... the boundary of time... What $$太極$$ arrived at, at the end of eternity, was despair...」

731:t_003:10.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's a fragment of $$至高神ソル$$, who took its own life. I figured it would surely become a power to strike down the $$御使い$$s.」

731:t_003:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「A $$シュロウガ$$ squad, and $$黒の英知$$ on top of it...!」

731:t_003:12.en:
$$シン$$
「So this is his trump card!」

731:t_003:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「Watch out! Something else is coming!」

731:t_004:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The servants of the $$御使い$$!」

731:t_004:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Do they plan to take us and $$アサキム$$ out in one sweep right here!」

731:t_004:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I can feel $$サクリファイ$$... She must be somewhere close...」

731:t_004:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$哀しみのサクリファイ$$... Do you mean to lend me your power to cover up your own sense of guilt...」

731:t_004:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like the two blacks are teaming up, black with black.」

731:t_004:8.en:
$$ベック$$
「Tch! Figures! Nobody who's into black is ever any good!」

731:t_004:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...I don't like it, $$サクリファイ$$. So that's how you do it, handing me alms from up on high.」

731:t_004:10.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then I'll teach you. This battle is the beginning of the banquet... the banquet of dread, where your 120 million years come to an end.」

731:t_004:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「...We've got no choice but to fight. We don't plan on dying either!」

731:t_004:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll show $$サクリファイ$$ too...! Our fight... and what has come of everything they've done!」

731:t_004:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「Our target is the $$シュロウガ$$ that $$アサキム$$ is riding! Take him down, and it's all over!」

731:t_004:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Watch out! Unlike our last battle, he's coming at us in earnest too!」

731:t_004:16.en:
$$桂$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$! I'm counting on you for what comes after!」

731:t_004:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「We've done all we could do! The rest is up to heaven...」

731:t_004:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「No... reeling in the victory from here on is up to you guys!」

731:t_004:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Right...! At this point, I'm not about to leave it up to God!」

731:t_004:21.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Let's make a miracle happen!」

731:t_004:22.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Let's make a miracle happen!」

731:t_004:23.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's right... As I thought, you people are wonderful.」

731:t_004:24.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アサキム$$! Now that it's come to this, we settle it with our fists!」

731:t_004:25.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The fight between you and us...! We end it here!」

731:t_004:26.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Wrong! This is where it begins!」

731:t_004:27.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now, ring the bell of battle! The banquet of the end begins now!!」
